items.title: A man sits down in front of a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park
items.summary: A man climbed two fences into the Land of the Tigers enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park near Doncaster and sat down in the grass in front of Altai, a five-year-old Amur tiger, which killed him. Phone footage of him sitting face to face with the tiger spread everywhere even as police asked people not to share it, and on Sunday the park said "many, many people" had contacted it and that Altai "is safe and well and will not be euthanised" (Pop Base's post of the news got 198K likes). X split between people relieved the tiger was spared and people calling the reaction callous toward the victim, later named as William Chapman, 24, whose family said he had a significant mental illness. Kelly Clarkson's follow-up in her Art of Play feud (172K) was the day's other big post.
items.author: @PopBase

post.name: Pop Base
post.text:
The tiger that attacked a man who entered its enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park will not be euthanized, park officials confirm.

(Via: @YorkshireWP)
